d: Diwali is more than a festival of lights—it is a crucial test of India's consumer spending and economic health. From festive sales and e-commerce discounts to rising prices of sweets, electronics and dry fruits, what are shoppers really buying this year? Online festive sales are projected to cross ₹1.5 lakh crore, but surveys point to cautious household spending. While online grocery, appliances and personal care see strong demand, smartphone purchases face a slowdown. Are Indians spending more or tightening their budgets? Firstpost decodes Diwali demand, consumer trends, festive sales…
